Permits & License Committee  August 14, 2025
Minutes  Page 1 of 7

  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  August 14, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
meeting ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on August 14, 2025 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh , Administration Department
  Angel -Leon Martell, Planning Department.
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LA County Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Boytrese Osias, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson , City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Sy’Naelyn Thomas, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the special meeting held on August 7, 2025

Permit(s):

Item #1:  LeGeorge Mauldin on behalf of 40 Love Foundation to host a Rackets & Ride Back to School
  Bash Event at 700 Warren Ln, Edward Vincent Jr. Park; Public Property; on Saturday, August
  30, 2025 from 10:00 a.m. - 2:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for 1 day
  event at Edward Vincent Park. Subject to Parks and Rec approval for use of the park;
  Approved Conditionally; Applicant to hire a minimum of six (6) professional-licensed security
  guards; Security staff shall monitor the restrooms being utilized by attendees to deter any
  outside lewd conduct activity; None Code Enforcement conditions;No additional
  requirements for Fire approval.; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activty No.
  00406254)
 Permits & License Committee  August 14, 2025
Minutes  Page 2 of 7

Item #2:  Otto Benedict on behalf of Live Nation to host a Chris Brown – Breezy Bowl XX Event at
  1001 Stadium Dr, SoFi Stadium; Private Property; on Saturday, September 13, 2025 from
  7:00 p.m. - 11:30 p.m. and Sunday, September 14, 2025 from 7:00 p.m. - 11:30 p.m.
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for 1 day event within SoFi Stadium; Approved;
  Approval for 1 day event within SoFi Stadium; Approved; Police Staffing TBD by the IPD
  Special Events Unit CONDITION: Code Enforcement staff to be assigned to this event
  (Vendor Enforcement); Sound should be tested inside Stadium bowl; No additional
  requirements for Fire approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activty No.
  00406246)

Item #3:  Aisha L. Thompson on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a 2025 Voter Registration
  “Votechella” Event at One W Manchester Blvd; City Hall South Lawn; Public Property; on
  Tuesday, September 16, 2025 from 6:00 p.m. - 8:30 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  Approval for 1 day event on City Hall South Lawn; Approved; IPD will staff two (2) Police
  Officers; Inglewood City Hall Security Officers (TBD) None Code Enforcement conditions; No
  additional requirements for Fire approval.; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly
  cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event
  shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activty No.
  00406248)

Item #4:  Daniel Medina on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a 2025 Hispanic Heritage Festival Event
  at Downtown Inglewood on Market St., from Florence Ave to Manchester Blvd; Public
  Property; on Saturday, September 20, 2025 from 11:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY Approval for 1 day event on Market Street between Florence Ave and
  Manchester Blvd, Subject to Public Works approval for use/closure of the right-of-way;
  Approved; Inglewood Police Department to provide One (1) Lt., One (1) Sgt., Eight (8)
  Officers for public safety and Twelve (12) TCO's for traffic safety - street closures; Applicant
  to request Meridian Barriers to be deployed by the Public Works Department;Approval for
  this event will come from the local Battalion Chiefs; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask
  wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal
  Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously
  (Activty No. 00406286)

Item #5:  Dionne Faulk on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a Darby Dixon Toy Giveaway Event at
  3215 Bartdon Ave; Public Property; on Saturday, December 6, 2025 from 9:00 a.m. - 11:00
 Permits & License Committee  August 14, 2025

  a.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for 1 day event within grass field on corner
  of Woodworth Ave and Bartdon Ave; There will be one (1) Sergeant, two (2) police officers
  deployed for public safety and two (2) City Hall Security Officers deployed to assist IPD with
  any potential crowd control; On 07/23/25, Event Organizer Malcolm Patton declined the need
  for TCO deployment (no street closures or use of the street); IPD watch commander will be
  notified and extra patrol-high visibility provided as time permits; None Code Enforcement
  conditions. No additional requirements for Fire approval.; Maintain site at all times, ensuring
  site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members
  working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face
  mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State
  health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activty No. 00406162)

New Business License Request (s):
Held-over on 8.14.25
Item #6:  Nima Mobasser DBA State Van Rental to operate as an Auto Rent / Lease at 800 S La Brea
  Ave. Item held over by Inglewood Police Department; IPD / Code Enforcement Department
  needs conduct an inspection; IPD must assess further; Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00406213)

Item #7:  Marc Leahy DBA South Park Doggie to operate as a Kennel at 8613 Aviation Blvd
  APPROVED CONDITIONALL SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Payment
  of annual business license and tax fees; Business owner must possess and maintain a
  current Animal Facility License from the Los Angeles County Animal Care and adhere to all
  rules and regulations; Business owner shall provide valid and current government-issued
  identification and copies of applicable state licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person
  operating within the establishment to the Finance Department; Applicant shall not employ or
  have on site anyone person that may pose a safety risk to the animals (i.e.: any person with
  prior convictions for any crimes against animals); Business owner shall maintain a clean /
  sanitized facility at all times to ensure the health & safety of all animals being serviced or
  housed at the establishment. Facility is subject to inspection by any Police, Code
  Enforcement or Animal Control Officer at any time (day or night). NO improper disposal of
  waste products of any kind. Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules
  and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any future
  business license application requests Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00406210)

Item #8:  Caroline Martinez DBA Milagro Cafe to operate as a Restaurant – Beer & Wine at 1315
  Centinela Ave APPROVED CONDITIONALL SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Obtain annual approval
  from the Permits and License Committee for events and live entertainment at the site; ALL
 Permits & License Committee  August 14, 2025
Minutes  Page 4 of 7

  patrons / employees shall have valid identification to be inside and remain as an employee
  or paying customer at the location (Bar area only). Valid ID shall be available upon request
  to any law enforcement or code enforcement officer(s); Applicant shall post NO LOITERING
  / PANHANDLING SIGNS in front / outside of the business as well; The applicant or his / her
  designee are subject to random permit & license / establishment inspections at ANYTIME of
  the day or night, by any police or code enforcement officer(s), including California
  Department of Alcohol Beverage Control Investigators. The purpose of random inspections
  are to ensure that the listed establishment are adhering to the regulations set forth by the
  State of California Alcohol Beverage Control, City of Inglewood / Permits & Licensing
  committee; Events with live entertainment shall be from 7:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m. Tuesday,
  Friday and Saturday; The number of events ending after midnight shall be limited to three
  events per month; Adhere to Resolution No. 1836 – SP -2019-005 in its entirety; and Adhere
  to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise
  and signage.Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the
  revocation of your business license and any future business license application
  requests Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00406135)

  unanimously:

New Tobacco License Renewal Request (s):

Item #10:  Yaya’s Island Mart to operate as a Tobacco Retailer at 1100 N La Brea Ave, #103 Hwy;
  This Business License has been APPROVED with the following condition set forth
  by the Permits and Licenses Committee:Must adhere to all City of Inglewood Municipal
  Codes (IMC), specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS FOR BUSINESSES
  ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere to all State and
  Federal Rules and Regulations; Retail area not exceed 25 % or More Square Feet of total
  retail floor area Sales or display of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of Flavored
  E-Cigarettes , Flavored Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored Cartridges,
  Menthol Cigarettes; Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored Smokeless
 Permits & License Committee  August 14, 2025
Minutes  Page 5 of 7

  Tobacco Products, Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own Tobacco,
  Flavored Tobacco rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are Strictly
  Prohibited;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age
  21 is strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall
  have a valid government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws
  restricting underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales or display
  of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly
  prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees are
  subject to random Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the day or
  night by any Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to
  enforce business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of
  Inglewood for Community Public Health & Safety;California State Board of Equalization
  Tobacco Retailers license must be current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products
  within existing business ONLY;NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah
  products) to minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related
  tobacco products SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction
  of underage tobacco use, including hookah products;Submit all state tobacco renewal
  certificates if applicable;NO loitering of persons outside of the location;NO LOITERING /
  PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST BE POSTED and visible to outside of the business. Proof
  of signage posted by applicant shall be submitted to finance (i.e. photo of signage); The
  following is not allowed: the “sales of Whippets are small cylinders of nitrous oxide”, the
  use of or illegal sales or cultivation of marijuana/cannabis products, any regulated cannabis
  products, any use or possession of illegal or unauthorized narcotics, narcotic paraphernalia
  per H&S11364.5 - i.e.; any pipes specifically used to ingest illegal narcotics, this would also
  include glass cylindrical, tube or bubble shaped pipes used specifically to smoke / ingest
  illegal narcotics. Sales of Tobacco pipes are acceptable; Applicant and employees are
  expected to be active participants in calling/notifying police for police related, unusual,
  illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police response or response from other city
  government services (i.e. Code Enforcement, Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept.,
  Etc.);Applicant and employees are expected to be active participants in calling/notifying
  police for police related, unusual, illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police
  response or response from other city government services (i.e. Code Enforcement,
  Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept., Etc.); andhe following is not allowed inside
  the business without proper authorization via the P&L Committee review and permit:
  PARTIES, SOCIAL EVENTS OR GATHERINGS OF ANYKIND, MUSIC BOXES (juke box),
  NO LIVE BANDS / MUSIC, DISC JOCKIES (DJ'S) PERFORMANCE, DANCE HALL, ETC.
  APPLICANT MUST HAVE REASONABLE BUSINESS HOURS (TIME OF DAY OR
  NIGHT) OF OPERATION. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00406234)
